channel.title: Via blog
channel.description: Posts about Via and its example boards. Via is an open-source package of tools, skills and checks for AI agents that design circuit boards.

item.title: Herald, a fire alarm communicator designed with Via
item.description: Herald is a fire alarm communicator. An AI agent designed it with Via from a written brief. The design file, the routed board and the results of the checks are in the Via repository.
